limitations: Independent agent review, not human ground truth. The reviewer authored evaluation examples and reviewed the opposite development split; no new verifier outputs or model calls were used for these decisions.

All 35 proposed passages were checked in the complete original development source and question context. All are at most 95 characters; 34 add a passage form and one already equals a legacy answer. These are annotation-level decisions, not new questions or measured quality improvements.

Some extracts rely on the cited source and question for pronoun or entity context, notably the amendment sentence beginning 'This'. Approval is only for the exact question, source revision and answerKey, never for that text in isolation or as a general whitelist.

Original corpus labels, legacy forms, evidence requirements, retrieval misses and the failed v1 qualification remain unchanged. This review approves only the nominated full supporting passages, not arbitrary surrounding sentences, shorter evidence quotations or semantic paraphrases.

The v2 proposal was motivated by the previously observed control-format failure as disclosed in REVIEW.md. Approval of these corpus forms is not an untouched-experiment claim and does not retroactively pass the old control. Brevity and legacy-form compatibility should remain separately reported.
